{"message": "Fixed the missing `compatible = "zephyr,retained-ram";` property on the `retainedmem` node in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/tests/subsys/settings/retention/boards/qemu_cortex_m3.overlay`.

### Cause of the Defect
In `tests/subsys/settings/retention/boards/qemu_cortex_m3.overlay`, the newly defined `/sram@2000f000/retainedmem` node (parent of `settings_partition0`) lacked `compatible = "zephyr,retained-ram";`. Because of this, `DT_HAS_ZEPHYR_RETAINED_RAM_ENABLED` was not set and the `retained_mem_zephyr_ram` driver did not instantiate the parent retained memory device (`__device_dts_ord_25`), resulting in an undefined reference linker error when `retention.c` referenced `DEVICE_DT_GET(DT_PARENT(DT_INST(0, zephyr_retention)))`.

### Fix
Added `compatible = "zephyr,retained-ram";` to the `retainedmem` node in `tests/subsys/settings/retention/boards/qemu_cortex_m3.overlay`, matching `nrf52840dk_nrf52840.overlay`. Built and ran the `settings_config` test suite on `qemu_cortex_m3`, confirming all 5 tests pass (`PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL`).", "kind": "FinishAction"}
